sentences.en: These clothes are not appropriate for a cold winter day.
sentences.zh: 这些衣服不适合寒冷的冬天。

sentences.en: Shizuko cheated in an examination and received an appropriate punishment.
sentences.zh: 市子在考试中作弊并受到了应有的惩罚。

sentences.en: You should take the appropriate measures at the appropriate time.
sentences.zh: 你应该在适当的时候采取适当的措施。

senses.zh: 私自挪用：take possession, without permission; 适当的：suitable, fitting

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ap（加强）+propri（拥有）+ ate（使…）→把公款变为自己拥有→私占
